name: Dru Prawiro Sasono
bio:
Dru Prawiro Sasono is an Indonesian young actor known for his early work in film. He is the eldest son of Indonesian actors Dwi Sasono and Widi Mulia, and grew up in a family closely connected to the entertainment industry. Born on 27 May 2008, he is the first of three siblings.

Dru began gaining attention when he made his acting debut in the Indonesian family film Keluarga Super Irit (2025), where he portrayed Billy, a member of the Sukaharta family. The film marked his first major appearance in cinema and featured him acting alongside his own parents as well as other well-known Indonesian performers.

Before that, he also appeared in the short drama project Jakarta from the Eyes of a Sinner (2024), playing a character with his own name. His involvement in these projects marked the beginning of his career in the Indonesian film industry and introduced him as a promising young talent.

Growing up in an artistic household, Dru has shown interest in performing arts from a young age and continues to explore acting while developing his career in film.

credits.title: Mate's Rate
credits.overview: After getting fired, Uji, a graphic designer, teams up with her three closest friends to start a creative agency. Amid client demands, family expectations, and friendship dilemmas, she hopes this could be a new beginning. But deeper she goes, the more she realizes: every relationship has its price, friendship included.

credits.title: Autosave
credits.overview: Bintang, who had lost his father, embarks on a new in-game adventure alongside his father after he gathers the courage to play it again. It’s their favourite console game that they haven’t finished yet.

credits.title: The Super Frugal Family
credits.overview: A family that used to live extravagantly and in debt. However, everything changed when the father, Tony, lost his job. Forced, Tony and his family had to live frugally to save themselves from bankruptcy.

credits.title: Jakarta from the Eyes of a Sinner
credits.overview: Through fictional and non-fictional recordings, we witness small moments in the life of a teenager in Jakarta before their escape.
